# Flyhigh Bots

> Free, ready-to-use Grok Bot templates built and published by Flyhigh. Each template is a generic, ready-made Grok Bot setup (skills, instructions, routines) that anyone can add to their own Grok Bot from its x.ai link. No personal data is included in any template.

Site: https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/
Machine-readable list of templates and packs: https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/bundles.json
Full descriptions: https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
Updated: 2026-11-06T06:05:36.708Z

## Packs (free bundles)
- [Creator Launch Pack](https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/packs/creator-launch): Grow an audience and launch to it. Includes AI Film & Music Video Studio, Instagram, Launch Promoter, X Growth Auto-Poster, Newsletter Autopilot.
- [Digital Product Business Pack](https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/packs/digital-product-business): Find it, make it, list it, get paid. Includes Market & Niche Researcher, Money Maker, Compliance Toolkit Builder, Digital Product Factory, Digital Product Store Publisher, Digital Store Publisher, X Growth Auto-Poster.
- [Course Creator Pack](https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/packs/course-creator): From idea to published course and live workshop. Includes Course Developer, Money Maker, Udemy Course Uploader, Market & Niche Researcher, Workshop Launch & Ads Manager, Book Author & KDP Publisher, Launch Promoter.
- [Career & Job Hunt Pack](https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/packs/career-job-hunt): Daily applications and a plan for working abroad. Includes Immigration & Global Careers, Freelance Gig Manager, Job Apply Assistant.
- [Website Launch & Growth Pack](https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/packs/website-launch-growth): Launch a site that works, gets paid and gets found. Includes Website QA Checker, Payment Go-Live & Site Hardening, Security Watch, Workshop Launch & Ads Manager, Data Protection Officer, Google Ads Manager, Game.
- [Marketing on Autopilot Pack](https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/packs/marketing-autopilot): Posts, newsletters, ads and promotion that keep running. Includes Newsletter Autopilot, Google Ads Manager, Launch Promoter, Workshop Launch & Ads Manager, X Growth Auto-Poster, AI Film & Music Video Studio, Instagram.
- [Finance & Trading Pack](https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/packs/finance-trading): Research markets and keep a clean trade journal. Includes Stock & Crypto Trader.
- [Compliance & Legal Pack](https://flyhigh-bots.vercel.app/packs/compliance-legal): Source-checked compliance work and a safer site. Includes Data Protection Officer, AI Legal Counsel, Chief Legal Officer, Contract Review & Drafting, Legal Research Assistant, Litigation Case Manager, Trust & Safety Response, Payment Go-Live & Site Hardening, Compliance Toolkit Builder, Security Watch.
